title: What if a levy on my wages is causing a hardship? | Internal Revenue Service
text: Skip to main content What if a levy on my wages is causing a hardship? More In News Working Families Tax Cuts News releases Tax relief in disaster situations Topics in the news Fact sheets IRS statements and announcements IRS Tax Tips IRS guidance Multimedia center Tax articles to share Posters to share Contact the IRS at the telephone number on the levy or correspondence immediately and explain your financial situation. Service is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. local time, Monday through Friday. If the levy is creating an immediate economic hardship , the levy may be released. A levy release does not mean you are exempt from paying the balance. The IRS will work with you to establish payment plans or take other steps to help you pay off the balance. To help ensure quick action, please have the fax number available for the bank or employer office that is processing the levy.
